summary: Two reminders Nora had set herself, coming due in the same room half an hour apart, no longer raise the same thing twice.
details: A proactive turn now sees what her own ambient loop already did in the group over the last 24 hours, with how long ago — the same record the participation turn has read since it shipped. Before this it could only see its own earlier message as an unlabelled line of chat, and raised again.
It still does not see the decision that scheduled it a second time: that intention is already in front of her, and reading it back twice only pushes toward speaking.
limitations: This is context, not a rule: nothing stops two raises half an hour apart, it is now her judgement whether the second one is worth making.
Two reminders coming due in the SAME minute were already merged into one turn; only ones spread across ticks were affected.
